facts.business: Simplex Realty Limited is engaged in real estate development and related activities in Mumbai and surrounding regions.
key_risks: Interest rate sensitivity and financing constraints affecting housing demand and developer liquidity
Rising construction costs due to inflation in raw materials (steel, cement) and labour
Affordability challenges in urban centres where price appreciation outpaces income growth
Global economic and geopolitical uncertainties including volatile oil prices, currency fluctuations, and capital flow instability
Regulatory and approval delays related to land acquisition, project clearances, and compliance
Inventory overhang in certain micro-markets, especially mid-income housing
Changing work patterns (hybrid/remote work) creating uncertainty in long-term office space demand
Environmental and climate-related risks (flooding, heat stress, unpredictable monsoons) impacting project viability and insurance costs
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions during the financial year were on an arm's length basis, in the ordinary course of business, and in compliance with applicable provisions. No transactions required reporting in Form AOC-2. No materially significant related party transactions with promoters, directors, KMPs, or other designated persons that may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large.
